title: relay_queue: dead-letter move block duplicated in DKIM failure and permanent failure paths
description: The 8-line dead-letter move loop (create dead_dir path, iterate [msg_path, env_path], rename each, warn on failure) appears identically in the DKIM signing failure arm (lines ~453-465) and the permanent delivery failure arm (lines ~519-530). Extract to an async helper: async fn move_to_dead_letter(&self, msg_path, env_path) to remove duplication.
